uk.s: Anthropic IPO xStocks Campaign Available on Binance Wallet
Subscription Application Period: 2026-11-18 06:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-18 14:00 (UTC)
Calculation Period: 2026-11-18 14:00 (UTC) Onwards
Binance Wallet will soon launch the Anthropic IPO xStocks Campaign. Eligible users can apply to participate in a non-guaranteed subscription process for Anthropic’s tokenized stocks via xStocks.

The IPO Campaign is designed to connect traditional capital markets with on-chain financial markets, enabling eligible users to submit subscription applications to be allocated Anthropic tokenized stocks upon Anthropic’s potential IPO. The role of Binance Wallet is limited to making the Campaign interface available to users and transmitting users’ subscription instructions to those parties.

If successful, your final token allocation will be calculated and the corresponding USDC will be deducted from your already-locked USDC amount. Once deducted, your Anthropic tokens and any USDC balance will both be transferred to your Binance Wallet. Please note that Anthropic tokenized stocks will be distributed at least 2 hours after the Nasdaq market opens.
Minimum Subscription Amount: 100 USDC
Users must complete applicable identity verification and compliance requirements, where applicable, and meet the participation conditions displayed on the campaign page.

Users who have completed identity verification and meet the eligibility requirements of the selected campaign may participate. Flash Earn Stake to Earn currently supports master accounts only. Sub-accounts and institutional accounts are not supported.

You can claim your accumulated rewards at any time from the relevant Flash Earn Stake to Earn campaign page. Alternatively, go to Assets > Earn, select the applicable order, and click Claim. All accumulated claimable rewards can be claimed in one action.

Who’s eligible for the Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) campaign?
Can I redeem my funds?
As Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) is a flexible product, you can redeem your funds anytime after subscription. You can redeem from either the campaign landing page or under Assets > Earn.

When the campaign ends, if you haven’t redeemed manually, we’ll automatically reinvest eligible crypto (such as USDT, OKB, and many others) into Simple Earn. Any unsupported crypto will be returned to your Funding account within 2 hours.
What rewards will I receive?
You’ll receive two types of rewards:
(1) an airdrop of a newly-listed token (principal-protected), and
(2) a base reward in your subscription crypto that’s generated with Simple Earn.
Learn more about
How are rewards calculated?
Rewards are calculated hourly.
Simple Earn rewards begin in the second hour after your funds are lent out. If not lent out, no rewards are generated.
Airdrop rewards for newly listed tokens also begin up to 2 hours after subscription.
If you redeem your funds within one hour after subscription, you won’t earn any rewards for that hour.
When are rewards distributed?
Rewards are distributed hourly. Rewards from a one-hour period will be distributed in the following hour after calculations are completed.
For example, rewards for the time period of 3:00 UTC to 4:00 UTC will be sometime between 4:00 and 5:00 UTC.
How do I claim my rewards?
Have more questions?
See the

The operator of Binance Wallet is a technology and infrastructure provider only. It is not licensed or regulated in any jurisdiction, carries on no regulated activity, and provides no investment, brokerage, placement, underwriting, custody, or advisory services.

Users who are successfully allocated will receive Anthropic tokenized stocks via xStocks after the issuance is completed, thereby obtaining price exposure to the Anthropic IPO. Please note that there is no guarantee that the user’s subscription application will be successful, as this will be determined by a number of factors. If the user’s subscription is not successful, the pledged funds will be refunded in full.
Subscription Application Timeline

Subscription will open at this time for all eligible users to apply. Please note that once committed, your USDC will be locked in a smart contract until final token distribution or refunded upon unsuccessful subscriptions. Binance Wallet does not take custody or control of those funds; they are held in a non-custodial smart contract.
Subscription closes and token allocation calculation begins.
Final Token Distribution: Exact Timing To Be Confirmed (TBC):
Note that the above timeline is subject to changes. If there are changes to listing dates or due to other circumstances, the timeline may be adjusted.
Subscription Details
Token Received: Anthropic Tokenized Stocks
Indicative Price Per Token: 70 USDC - 78 USDC (excluding fees)
Partner Service Fee (xStocks): 5%
Implied Valuation: $1.26 trillion - $1.41 trillion
Supported Subscription Token: USDC
Total Subscription Cap：500 million USDC
This subscription adopts the Binance Wallet Alpha Points tiered quota system. The maximum quota for each user is determined based on their Alpha Points balance, as follows:
Alpha Points > 0: Quota of 20,000 USDC
Alpha Points > 40: Quota of 100,000 USDC
Alpha Points > 100: Quota of 200,000 USDC
Alpha Points > 200: Quota of 500,000 USDC
In addition, users who hold the Trenchers Badge will receive a bonus quota of 50,000 USDC on top of the tier they qualify for based on their Alpha Points balance.
Project Details: Anthropic IPO Tokenized Stocks

The project is under Binance Wallet’s IPO Access and will be made available to eligible users, such that they can submit subscription applications for a chance to be allocated Anthropic tokenized stock.
The prices displayed during the campaign period are only for reference.
The final offering price will be determined after the subscription period ends by the issuer and the underwriters, based on market demand, valuation levels, and issuance arrangements.
Submitting a subscription application does not guarantee final allocation.
What Will Users Receive After Allocation Is Completed
Users who are successful in their subscription applications will receive Anthropic tokenized stocks.
Anthropic tokenized stocks do not represent direct ownership of Anthropic shares and do not constitute ownership of Anthropic stock.
Holders do not enjoy shareholder voting rights, dividend rights, or any other shareholder rights.
Please note, xStocks and its allocator/distributor reserves the right to distribute the relevant tokenized shares as bStocks, via smart contract, directly to users.

Eligible users may participate in the campaign via the Binance Wallet IPO Campaign page once the campaign is open by applying for a subscription, or click the campaign link to participate (requires opening on a mobile device) :
Binance App > Wallet > Home (Discover) > Anthropic IPO xStocks Campaign
Due to regulatory requirements and regional restrictions, users from certain countries or regions may not be able to participate in this campaign.
Allocation Mechanism
Submitting a subscription application only represents an expression of subscription interest and does not guarantee that the application will receive an allocation of Anthropic tokenized stocks.
Allocation results will be determined by the issuer and the underwriters based on market demand and the final allocation mechanism.
Users may receive full allocation, partial allocation, or no allocation.
Binance Wallet does not participate in the final offering price determination, in the allocation of subscriptions, or in the issuance or distribution of Anthropic tokenized stocks.
After allocation is completed:
Users who are successful in their application will receive the corresponding amount of Anthropic tokenized stocks;
Any unallocated amount or unused funds will be automatically returned to the user’s wallet;
The specific token distribution and refund timing shall be subject to the announcements on the campaign page.

Note: There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise.
